§10.5.1 Fields Outside the Form

📄 Page rule — applied from the page alone

forms-fields-outside-the-form · forms

✅ Normative

A field printed in a header, a footer or anywhere outside the main form body MUST still be rendered. A field printed above the form MUST be placed before the form content; any other such field MUST be placed after it.

CORRECTED, Final K-1, Amended K-1 sit outside the ruled form body and are easy to sweep past, but each changes what the whole document means: a K-1 marked Amended is not the same filing as one that is not.

Non-field text

Instructions, preambles and fine print on a form page MUST be transcribed at their printed reading position, between the fields they accompany. They MUST NOT be gathered at the end of the region or dropped.

✅ Sample — an instruction between two sections

"Skip this section if both parties signed Section 12 above." sits between the section 13 heading and its first field, in blue. It is not a field and is transcribed where it is printed.
